comment: KOTOR III (fan) opening scene. Seren Vaux, a courier on Citadel Station, carries the Exile's last recording. Original writing for this fan project.

entries.text: Hold a moment. Everyone on this dock walks past me, but you slowed down. I have been carrying a message for three years, and I think it was meant for you.
From a ship that left Telos after the Sith Lords fell. It carried a Jedi past the edge of every star chart, chasing someone who had gone ahead.
No one on this station says that name out loud anymore. The recording came back on an automated drone, with a set of coordinates and a warning.
That the Sith we fought were only the outer edge of something larger. An empire, old and patient, waiting in the dark beyond the charts. And that it is almost ready to come home.
Because the recording is sealed with the Force. It opens only for someone who carries it the way she did. When you walked past, the seal lit up in my hands.
Meet me at the docking ring when you are ready. Bring a ship that can make the long jump, and friends who will not turn back when the stars run out.
Suit yourself. The message is not going anywhere, and neither am I. But whatever she found out there will not wait forever.

Then I am coming with you. My courier shuttle is fuelled, and the credits I just handed you will cover the clearance fee. The security officer on this dock still has to clear the shuttle before we lift.
You came back. Good. The seal has not gone quiet since you left, and in all this time it has never answered anyone else.

replies.text: The Exile. You are talking about the Exile.
Then I will go. Tell me where.
I need time to think about this.
Why wait for a ship? I am ready to leave today.
Then tell me again. Why does it answer to me?
First, repeat the warning for me.
